context.action: Disengaged defensive idle; actual incoming damage type, wyvern present/absent state and current/maxHP checked

definitions.rationale: Nexus fixed Shining One/Utu Grip with base Nyame and defensive accessories; the guide has no idle grid. No source cap totals, path or rank inherited.

context.action: Disengaged DRG99/WHM49 with learned Cure III (46MP), positive usable maxMP and actual MP deficit; self or eligible ally in 20 yalms, actual recast

definitions.rationale: Nexus useful-MP recovery: Nyame Mail MP and two physical Stikini Ring +1 copies. No blanket DRG MP exemption; casting under the real HP threshold may also trigger defensive-wyvern Healing Breath, which is not promised.

context.action: Engaged neutral attacks with wyvern actually present (Sroda pet-alive effect) and actual /SAM Hasso/haste state checked

definitions.rationale: Nexus fixed Shining One and Endgame-grid accessories with Ptero. Brais +3 (exact tier from Pre-Ody grid) instead of source +4; base Coiste Bodhar, no R20. Literal STR/DA cape chosen where source thread reads Dex/Str. No delay cap or optimal TP loop certified.

context.action: Engaged mitigation alternative; actual incoming damage type, current/maxHP and wyvern state checked

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo DT swaps applied to the Nexus balanced base (Ptero. Brais +3 for source +4; base Gleti body). No damage-taken cap or survival promise.

context.action: Engaged accuracy alternative with wyvern present; actual target evasion and hit rate unknown, actual haste checked

definitions.rationale: Galkapryme Acc w/Wyvern accessories with Nexus Chirich Ring +1 for Varar Ring +1 (pet applicability not inferred); base Dgn. Collar +2 and Pel. Earring +2 only, no rank or random augment. Not capped accuracy.

context.action: Impulse Drive granted by equipped exact Shining One regardless of quest/skill; >=1000 usable TP and eligible enemy at execution

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo Impulse Drive grid with exact Shining One/Utu Grip; Ptero. Fin. G. +3 replaces source +4 and base Gleti body replaces R20+. Shining One TP-scaled crit bonus is not a universal hold-TP rule; Moonshade effective TP is not usable TP.

context.action: Stardiver requires DRG main, completed Martial Mastery and at least one Stardiver merit; >=1000 usable TP and eligible enemy

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo Stardiver grid with Nexus Shining One instead of source Trishula: no Aeonic TP bonus, aftermath or skillchain property transferred. Base Gleti/Nyame, no R20/R25.

context.action: Sonic Thrust native DRG80 polearm 300; >=1000 usable TP; frontal area may engage additional targets; actual skill level

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo shared Camlann/Sonic grid without Rhongomiant (Empyrean context not transferred); Ptero. Fin. G. +3 for +4. Area susceptibility and extra enmity actual.

context.action: Jump or High Jump activation in range (9.5/11.5 yalms), actual recast; gear worn when the jump executes

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo Jump grid with exact Vishap Mail +3/Vis. Fng. Gaunt. +3 (Galkapryme tier; BG lists the same All Jumps TP bonus as +4) and Ptero. Brais +3; two physical Chirich copies. No Ryunohige forced crit or attack bonus.

context.action: Spirit Jump with wyvern actually present for doubled TP/forced crit/attack bonus; actual recast and range

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo Spirit Jump swaps on the Nexus jump base: Peltast Cuissots +3 attack+19% and Schynbalds +3 TP+90 from public pages. No TP total certified.

context.action: Soul Jump with wyvern actually present for forced crit/triple TP/attack bonus; actual recast and range

definitions.rationale: Boposhopo Soul Jump body/hands swaps; source Valorous Greaves random augments not invented, Ostro Greaves retained. Base Gleti gauntlets only.

context.action: Call Wyvern activation (wyvern absent, Spirit Surge inactive, actual recast); Ptero. Mail +3 worn at time of use

definitions.rationale: Nexus defensive base plus source Call Wyvern body. Trait modifications persist until wyvern dies, is dismissed or DRG zones; later body swaps do not remove them. Support-job trait totals not certified.

context.action: Spirit Link activation with wyvern below 100% HP unless Empathy merited; 12-17% actual current master HP consumed; actual recast

definitions.rationale: Source Spirit Link swaps on the Nexus defensive base. Source Empathy feet annotation is not in the public +3 description and is not certified; ailment removal by Peltast hands per Spirit Link page.

context.action: Restoring Breath (DRG90) forcing Healing Breath, or a real defensive-wyvern spell trigger below threshold; breath-potency gear worn when the breath resolves; wyvern max HP gear already counted

definitions.rationale: Nexus breath set: Ptero. Armet +3 72/256 plus base Brigantia 38/256 exceeds the 96/256 cap, so Glassblower's Belt and augmented Updraft Mantle are not required; Vishap Brais +3/Ptero. Greaves +3 wyvern HP. No healing amount or cap position certified.

context.action: Steady Wing (DRG95) with wyvern present; wyvern HP+ gear worn through at least one tic before use, actual recast

definitions.rationale: Source Steady Wing pieces at exact +3 (source +4 legs/feet not transferred) on the defensive base. HP+ swap at use does not count; absorb amount not certified.
